title: PaymentsPrimitivesPaymentRecordsResourceAmount
description: A representation of an amount of money, consisting of an amount and a currency.

currency.description: Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).

value.description: A positive integer representing the amount in the currency's [minor unit](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies#zero-decimal). For example, `100` can represent 1 USD or 100 JPY.
